body:
At Enliven, we are dedicated to help bridge the gap between elders and youth through meaningful exchange. We create concerts and performances small and large to engage seniors of all abilities.

Youth share their musical talents and cultural perspectives to entertain and uplift their audiences. Elders share their love, wisdom and support to the students. This exchange offers an enriching experience for both the elders and the youth, helping create special bonds and memories for all.

heroPhoto.alt: Students and residents gathered together after a performance

estNote: Founded by students in Newton, MA. Now across Greater Boston.

team.name: Aria Malhotra
team.bio: Aria is passionate about women’s empowerment and bringing people together. She has always enjoyed singing and dancing, with music being a big part of her life. She helped create Enliven as a platform to foster meaningful connections across generations through performance and dialogue.

team.name: Reyva Choudhry
team.bio: Reyva is passionate about STEM and making a positive impact in her community. Outside of academics, she is a varsity swimmer for her school, a Bollywood dancer, and a Model UN delegate.

team.name: Saanvi Sharma
team.school: Nobles and Greenough School - Class of 2029
team.bio: Saanvi has been part of the Enliven volunteer team since 6th grade. She enjoys musical theater and singing. She enjoys interacting with people of all backgrounds and giving back to the community in creative ways.

team.name: Teya Mahanama
team.school: Nobles and Greenough School - Class of 2029
team.bio: Teya Mahanama enjoys playing the guitar, ballet and being part of the Crew team at her school.

team.name: Aneesha Khanna
team.bio: Aneesha enjoys reading, baking and listening to music. At school, she does debate, mock trial, and sings with her school chorus. She enjoys public speaking and anything to do with music!
